desc: The best way to control Claude Code, Codex and more from any computer or phone

The AI-native engine for teams and their agents. Multi-harness, multi-agent, self-hosted.

Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.

When Claude Code hits its usage limit, Codex picks the task up from the same memory. Sno Station puts Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on one squad: they hand work to each other and review each other's code. Open source, runs on your computer.
